title: Rethink: one rung deeper — the floor answers, the specialists score, the encoder thinks
intro: Press play to walk the flow one step at a time, or click a dot to jump.

walk.title: Your question
walk.text: A state plus typed questions, on your machine — the same wire the free floor speaks. Nothing leaves by default.

in.label: POST /decide

walk.title: The fused gate
walk.text: The free floor's confidence check runs first. On this harder triage question it abstains — every outcome comes back null — and only that abstain moves up the ladder.

in.label: POST /decide · a harder question
in.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (abstained request)

out.label: not sure: every outcome is null
out.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (abstained response)

walk.title: Sure — nothing leaves
walk.text: When the floor is sure, the answer returns in microseconds with a receipt — hashes of the input and the decision, not your data — and no rung above is paid.

in.label: POST /decide
in.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (answered request)

out.label: sure: outcome yes
out.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (answered response)

walk.title: The bag rung scores the survivors
walk.text: The abstained question goes to small per-domain scorers over hashed word-count features — CPU-class, cheap enough to run anywhere. A confident bag pick answers right here.

walk.title: Too coarse — the encoder thinks
walk.text: Where a bag view is too coarse, a trained encoder head reads the question as a whole and thinks — GPU-hosted, weights that never leave our servers. The hosted lane is planned; this is the public request it would carry, and its reply is published when the lane opens.

in.label: the abstained question, sent up
in.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (abstained request)

walk.title: The hosted vessel
walk.text: One locked file holds the head — hashed, signed, applied whole. Weights never leave hardware we control.
